To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the DOM-based translation provides the most flexible and efficient method for XML-based management to access legacy SNMP agent, and SOAP-based translation provides the simplest and most efficient method for the gateway manager to advertise the translation service.
we propose three methods to translate interactions between an XML-based network manager and a legacy SNMP agent.
we propose three interaction translation methods for the XML/SNMP gateways.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new XML/SNMP gateways, which provide a method of interaction translation between the XML-based management and the SNMP agent, in order to support integrated network management.
the development of the XML-based network manager that manages the legacy network devices equipped with SNMP agents.
the translation method of the XML/SNMP interaction in XML-based network management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
each of the three methods has its own advantages, and each method is applicable to different situations.
the SOAP-based translation provides a more flexible translation mechanism for the XML/SNMP gateways, but the HTTP-based translation provides a better performance.
the proposed methods can be used to integrate XML/SNMP-based management system with the legacy SNMP agent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the DOM-based translation is the most suitable method for the XML/SNMP interaction, and the SOAP-based translation is a promising method to be adopted in the future XML/SNMP gateways.
the XML/SNMP translation methods can provide a flexible and extensible way of managing legacy SNMP agents in an integrated management system.
we have provided the translation methods for interaction between the XML-based network manager and the SNMP-based legacy network agent.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the XML/SNMP gateways should provide a translation method to support both XML-based manager and SNMP-based manager in the integrated management systems.
XML-based network management can manage networks equipped with the legacy SNMP agent through the XML/SNMP gateways, which translate the interaction messages from the manager to the agent.

the DOM-based translation is the best choice for the XML/SNMP gateways because the DOM interface can be used for the direct access of management information and the DOM-based translation does not have any additional overhead for translation.
